item.title: In the ashes of Lirquén: How a small town is rising from Chile's devastating wildfires
item.description: LIRQUÉN, Chile (AP) — The thick smoke hovering over the city is a grim reminder that the flames are still nearby.

item.title: Malkin, Novak lead Pittsburgh Penguins past Calgary Flames 4-1
item.description: CALGARY — Tommy Novak and Evgeni Malkin had a goal and an assist each on Wednesday to lead the Pittsburgh Penguins to a 4-1 NHL victory over the Calgary Flames. Yegor Chinakhov and Bryan Rust also scored for Pittsburgh (24-14-11).

item.title: Sundance first look: Chris Pine and Jenny Slate in the delicate romantic drama 'Carousel'
item.description: PARK CITY, Utah (AP) — Chris Pine gets a lot of scripts sent his way, but when Rachel Lambert’s “Carousel” landed on his proverbial desk it was like he’d stumbled on something from a different filmmaking era.

item.title: Canucks rally from two-goal deficit to beat Capitals, snap 11-game winless streak
item.description: VANCOUVER — The Vancouver Canucks erased a 2-0 deficit and snapped an 11-game winless streak with a 4-3 victory over the Washington Capitals on Wednesday night.

item.title: Barnes, Raptors heat up in third quarter to beat Kings 122-109
item.description: SACRAMENTO, Calif. (AP) — Scottie Barnes scored 14 of his 23 points in the third quarter and the Toronto Raptors beat the Sacramento Kings 122-109 on Wednesday night.

item.title: Larkin scores in OT as Red Wings beat Maple Leafs 2-1
item.description: TORONTO (AP) — Dylan Larkin scored at 3:07 of overtime as the Detroit Red Wings downed the Toronto Maple Leafs 2-1 on Wednesday night. Simon Edvinsson also scored for Detroit. John Gibson made 30 saves.

item.title: Rally outside Victoria courthouse calls for action on intimate partner violence
item.description: Dozens of people gathered outside the Victoria courthouse Wednesday to demand urgent action in the wake of the death of 41-year-old Laura Gover.
